column1: # The id is dotted and the dots are the tree: "apps.terminal" is a row under
# "apps", and "apps" is a row on the root menu. A row with no action is a
# submenu; a row with one runs it with `bash -c`, so a pipeline is allowed and
# Ids are also the routes `strapd menu summon <route>` takes, which is why
# `apps` and `system` are spelled the way keybindings/actions.toml spells them.
# There are no icons here. Picking glyphs is the same UX-tier decision as
# picking the rows, and neither is settled.
# Labels have to be unique within one submenu: the menu returns the label of
# the row that was picked, and test/shell.d/menu-test.sh fails on a collision.
